title: Geomaster Failures (Public Stamp below 90% API Success)
description:
The API success of the below Stamp is less than 90% in the last one hour. Use the Stamp Jarvis Dashboard link for further investigation.

Global Geomaster Dashboard

Regional Geomaster Dashboard (rgm-prod-bay - change to affected geomaster)

Some of the TSGs:

1. The issue may be transient, self healing, occur for less than one hour, and not require a root cause analysis. This could be due to some instances reimaging or upgrading which would cause them to briefly not process requests.

2. Automorphism automatically scales up the hosting DB (default is P1) if usage is high. Check if scale up is triggered & finished. If not, scale up the hosting database using the portal or automorphism (Database auto scaling (Web view)).

If you see that scaling up operation is stuck for a long time, this might be due to stuck, long running transactions. There is apparently a fix for that in ANT75. However, in the mean time you can identify these transactions and kill them. 

a. Get the hosting database connection string via secret store manager, or get RDP access to any controller role instance. Decrypt the connection string. (How to decrypt Antares ConnectionStrings in registry and database and from secret store for troubleshooting (Web view))

b. Connect to the hosting database via SQL Server Management Studio using the connection string and run the query below. The query will identify all transactions running for longer than 2 days. 

select dt.transaction_id, dt.database_transaction_state, dt.database_transaction_begin_time, st.is_user_transaction, st.open_transaction_count, st.session_id, es.login_time

from sys.dm_tran_database_transactions dt

join sys.dm_tran_session_transactions st on st.transaction_id = dt.transaction_id

join sys.dm_exec_sessions es on es.session_id = st.session_id

where dt.database_id >= 5 and database_transaction_type = 1 and es.login_time <= getutcdate() - 2 

c. Kill transactions using the pids in the query result.

kill <pid>


3. Try mitigations explained in this TSG:TSG: GeomasterApiSubscriptionImpactAllRequests  (Web view). If indeed a single or few subscriptions are verified as making huge amounts of API calls and hogging resources, follow the throttling steps described there. Otherwise, avoid random or unnecessary throttling, and escalate or transfer the incident.


4. Check API traffic distribution between the Controller Role instances on the stamp. There are two ways to do this:


First Method:

You can check the number of 40006 events on each controller. 40006 is the eventId for APIs. Use this query:

AntaresAdminControllerEvents

| where PreciseTimeStamp >= ago(90m) // double check this time aligns with when the alert fired

| where EventPrimaryStampName == "<stampName>"

| where EventId == 40006

| where RoleInstance startswith "ControllerRole_IN"

| summarize count() by bin(PreciseTimeStamp, 10m), RoleInstance

| render timechart


Second Method:

The other way to do this would be to look at the StatsCounterFiveMinuteTable table. Use this query:

StatsCounterFiveMinuteTable

| where TIMESTAMP >= ago(90m) // double check this time aligns with when the alert fired

| where EventPrimaryStampName == "<stampName>"

| where RoleInstance startswith "ControllerRole_IN"

| where CounterName == "\\W3SVC_W3WP(_Total)\\Active Requests"

| project TIMESTAMP, RoleInstance, CounterValue

| render timechart


You may find that 1 or more controllerRole instances are not handling traffic (i.e. they are limping along) and most of the traffic is being handled by other controllers. In this case, do the following:

  1. Keep one instance in broken state and reimage the rest, one instance at a time (make sure you leave one in bad/broken state)
  2. Quickly RDP to the one 'bad' instance and grab a memory dump (instructions here --> Memory dumps | App Service TSG (eng.ms))
  3. Still in the RDP session, take this instance out of rotation by adding this regKey --> REG ADD "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\IIS Extensions\Web Hosting Framework" -v VmssInstanceStatus -d 0x0 -t REG_DWORD -f
  4. RA/Engage the VMSS team to RCA what's going on with the bad instance


5. Loop in Control Plane owners : AntMgmt Servicing Team in IcM. Take a memory dump when transferring the incident so Control Plane can analyze it later.

6. Restart an affected worker process instance.

7. Reboot, upgrade, or reimage the affected instance. Before doing so, please note: if you end up needing to reboot any of the GeoMasterRole instances, please take a dump of the two w3wp processes. Follow this TSG (note that you may need to search around for procdump.exe; it's not in the same location on GeoMasters as on controllers): TSG How to create a memory dump when controller does not process requests (Web view)

primaryKustoQuery.title: Primary kusto query
primaryKustoQuery.kustoQuery:
let publicStamps = (RoleInstanceHeartbeat
    | where PreciseTimeStamp > now() - 1h
    | where PreciseTimeStamp < now()    | where EventStampType == "Stamp"
    | summarize by EventPrimaryStampName);
AntaresAdminGeoEvents 
| where PreciseTimeStamp > now() - 1h
    | where PreciseTimeStamp < now()
| where EventId == 40006 and (isempty(StampName) or StampName in (publicStamps)) and StampName !contains ".api."
| where IsGeomasterByEventStampName(EventStampName) 
| where StampName != "waws-prod-msftintdm3-501" 
| project StatusCode, StampName, SubscriptionId, EventStampName, SourceNamespace
| summarize totalReqs = count() , failedReqs = countif(StatusCode >= 500), TotalSubs = dcount(SubscriptionId), FailingSubs=dcountif(SubscriptionId,StatusCode >= 500) by StampName, EventStampName, SourceNamespace
| extend availability = 100 - (failedReqs * 100.0 / totalReqs), impactedSubs = FailingSubs * 100.0 / TotalSubs
| where totalReqs > 1000
| where availability < 90 and impactedSubs > 5 and isnotempty(StampName)
| extend SliceOverride = StampName, CorrelationIdOverride = "StampAPIAlert"
| extend CorrelationId = strcat(EventStampName, "=>", StampName)
    , titlePrefix = iif(SourceNamespace == "WAWS" and StampName !contains "int", "[AppServiceCP][AutoComms],", "[AppServiceCP],")
    , MonitorId = strcat(SourceNamespace, iif(StampName contains "int", "Not", ""), "ApiAutoPost")
| extend JarvisDashboard = strcat("https://wawshealth.azurewebsites.windows.net/VisualApi/JarvisDashboard?stampName=", StampName)

| extend availability = 100-(failedReqs*100.0/totalReqs), impactedSubs = FailingSubs*100.0/TotalSubs

| where availability < 90 and impactedSubs > 5  and StampName != ""
| extend SliceOverride = StampName, CorrelationIdOverride = "StampAPIAlert"
| extend CorrelationId=strcat(EventStampName,"=>", StampName), titlePrefix = iif(SourceNamespace == "WAWS", "[AppServiceCP][AutoComms],", "[AppServiceCP],"), MonitorId = strcat(SourceNamespace, "ApiAutoPost")
| extend JarvisDashboard = strcat("https://wawshealth.azurewebsites.windows.net/VisualApi/JarvisDashboard?stampName=", StampName)

secondaryKustoQueries.title: Availability
secondaryKustoQueries.kustoQuery: let publicStamps = (RoleInstanceHeartbeat | where PreciseTimeStamp > ago(1h) | where EventStampType == "Stamp" | summarize by EventPrimaryStampName); let stamps=toscalar(AntaresAdminGeoEvents | where TIMESTAMP > ago(1h) | where EventId == 40006 and (StampName == "" or StampName in (publicStamps)) and StampName !contains ".api." and Address !has "/metrics?" | where EventStampName == extract("^([^=>]+)", 1, "{correlationId}") | project StatusCode, StampName, SubscriptionId, EventId, EventStampName | summarize totalReqs = count() , failedReqs = countif(StatusCode >= 500),TotalSubs=dcount(SubscriptionId), FailingSubs=dcountif(SubscriptionId,StatusCode >= 500) by StampName, EventStampName | extend availability = 100-(failedReqs*100.0/totalReqs), impactedSubs = FailingSubs*100.0/TotalSubs | where totalReqs > 1000 | where availability < 90 and impactedSubs > 5 | summarize makeset(StampName,100)); AntaresAdminGeoEvents | where TIMESTAMP > ago(6h) | where EventId == 40006 and StampName in (stamps) | where EventStampName == extract("^([^=>]+)", 1, "{correlationId}") | extend CorrelationId=strcat(EventStampName,"=>", StampName) | where CorrelationId == "{CorrelationId}" | summarize totalReqs = count() , failedReqs = countif(StatusCode >= 500) by StampName, EventStampName,bin(TIMESTAMP,1m) | extend availability = 100-(failedReqs*100.0/totalReqs) | project StampName , TIMESTAMP , availability | evaluate pivot(StampName,avg(availability))
